texts.zh:
我们在[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站汇报，在最近一次地表地址调查之后丢失了一个补给箱。

在追踪补给箱地理定位的过程中，我们发现它被一座当地村庄发现并占为己有。

我们补给箱的混入可能对[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的发展带来不利影响。
texts.en:
Our observation post above [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has reported missing supply crates following a recent geological survey on the surface.

While tracking the geolocators on the supplies, we have discovered that a local village has found and claimed these resources for themselves.

The introduction of our storage containers may have an adverse effect on the development of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

texts.zh:
看来，误入[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的补给箱存对当地文化产生了奇怪的影响。

当地[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]居民建造了我们观测飞船的粗糙仿制品。虽然这些“船”显然没有功能，但这证明我们的研究人员在调查期间被当地人发现了。

在一位当地长老的指导下，可以看到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]队模仿我们的地质土壤分析程序：把我们不当处置的板条箱装满泥土和岩石，把它们装上他们的“船”，耐心地等待。
texts.en:
It would appear that the misplaced inventory on [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has had a strange impact on the native culture.

The [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] population has built crude imitations of our own observation shuttles. While these "ships" are obviously non functional, this is evidence that our researchers were spotted by locals during their survey.

Under the guidance of a local elder, the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] can be seen performing an imitation of our geological soil analysis procedure: filling our misplaced crates we left behind with dirt and rocks, loading them onto their "ships", and waiting patiently.

texts.zh: [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]以为模仿我们的行为，就会有更多的货物出现。我们应该在这种行为对社会造成更大影响之前进行干预。
texts.en: The [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are under the impression that by mimicking our processes, more supplies will appear. We should intervene before this behavior impacts their wider society.

texts.zh: 这么做就是徒劳，等来的只会有死亡。
texts.en: This practice is ultimately futile, only death awaits.

texts.zh:
从[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]取回我们丢失的箱子后，装载“飞船”的仪式仍持续了一阵子，直到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]愤怒地找到村庄长老，然后把他们丢进仿造的“穿梭机”并烧成了灰烬。

尽管人们已经回归了此前的日常，但他们的文化里对“天人”的怨恨仍然挥之不去。
texts.en:
After recovering our lost crates from [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the "ship" loading rituals continued for a short while, until the angry [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] locals turned on their village elder, throwing them into the makeshift shuttle before burning it to ashes.

Although the population has returned to their previous routines, their culture retains a lingering resentment towards the "sky people".
